searchText:
constant volume
chamber (fc) simscapeblock fuelcell_lib control constant volume
chamber (fc) this block models mass and energy capacitance in a fuel cell network. the chamber represents a control volume of a gas mixture which exchanges material and energy with the rest of the network via one or more ports. the volume contains states for the varying pressure, temperature and species composition of its contents. species can phase change to liquid if they reach their saturation. condensed species are removed from the chamber. the chamber can exchange heat with the environment through its thermal port.

a, b, c, d - fuel cell conserving ports associated with the chamber inlets.

h -- thermal conserving port associated with the thermal mass of the gas in the volume.

min [kg/s] -- [4x1] time varying vector representing mass flows of the species being added to or removed from the volume. this port is intended to allow for chemical and separation reactions to be represented in an external block.

tin [k] -- time varying temperature of the species being added via the *min* port.

p [pa] -- pressure of the gas in the chamber.

t [k] -- temperature of the gas in the chamber.

x_i [1] -- [4x1] species mass fractions in the chamber.

y_i [1] -- [4x1] species mole fractions in the chamber.

pipe (fc) simscapeblock fuelcell_lib signal-processing pipe (fc) this block models pipe flow dynamics for a fuel cell network due to viscous friction losses and convective heat transfer with the pipe wall. choked flow occurs when the outlet reaches sonic condition. the pipe contains a constant volume of fuel cell gas. the pressure and temperature evolve based on the compressibility and thermal capacity of the fuel cell gas volume. condensation can occur for species that are beneath their critical point.

a, b - fuel cell conserving ports associated with the pipe inlet and outlet.

h - thermal conserving port associated with the pipe wall.

tin [k] -- time varying temperature of the species being added or removed via the *min* port.

p [pa] -- pressure of the gas in the chamber.

t [k] -- temperature of the gas in the chamber.

f - physical signal port reporting fuel cell volume measurements. connect to a measurement selector (fc) block.
